mapper.sql: purchase_returns.id AS id, purchase_returns.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, purchase_returns.purchase_order_id AS purchaseBillId, purchase_orders.po_code AS purchaseBillCode, purchase_returns.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, purchase_returns.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, purchase_returns.location_group_id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, purchase_returns.location_id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, purchase_returns.order_date AS orderDate, purchase_returns.note AS note, purchase_returns.pr_code AS prCode, purchase_returns.ap_id AS apId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS apName, purchase_returns.vat_chart_account_id AS vatChartAccountId, purchase_returns.vat_calculate AS vatCalculate, purchase_returns.total_amount AS subTotal, purchase_returns.vat_setting_id AS vatSettingId, vat_settings.name AS vatSettingName, purchase_returns.total_amount + purchase_returns.total_vat AS total, purchase_returns.total_vat AS totalVat, purchase_returns.vat_percent AS vatPercentage, purchase_returns.balance AS balance, purchase_returns.status AS status, purchase_returns.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, purchase_returns.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM purchase_returns LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON purchase_returns.currency_center_id = currency_centers.id LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_returns.purchase_order_id = purchase_orders.id LEFT JOIN companies ON purchase_returns.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN vendors ON purchase_returns.vendor_id = vendors.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON purchase_returns.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN locations ON purchase_returns.location_id = locations.id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON purchase_returns.ap_id = chart_accounts.id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON purchase_returns.vat_setting_id = vat_settings.id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON purchase_returns.created_by = users1.id LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON purchase_returns.modified_by = users2.id

mapper.select: SELECT purchase_return_receipts.id AS id, purchase_return_receipts.purchase_return_id AS billReturnId, purchase_return_receipts.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, companies.currency_center_id AS baseCurrencyCenterId, base.name AS baseCurrencyCenterName, base.symbol AS baseCurrencyCenterSymbol, purchase_return_receipts.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencyCenterSymbol, (SELECT rate_to_purchase FROM company_currencies WHERE currency_center_id = currency_centers.id AND exchange_rate_id = purchase_return_receipts.exchange_rate_id LIMIT 1) AS rateToSell, purchase_return_receipts.receipt_code AS receiptCode, purchase_return_receipts.amount_us AS paidUsd, purchase_return_receipts.amount_other AS paidOther, purchase_return_receipts.total_amount AS totalAmount, purchase_return_receipts.balance AS balance, purchase_return_receipts.balance_other AS balanceOther, purchase_return_receipts.due_date AS aging, DATE(purchase_return_receipts.created) AS `date` FROM purchase_return_receipts INNER JOIN purchase_returns ON purchase_returns.id = purchase_return_receipts.purchase_return_id INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = purchase_returns.company_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers AS base ON base.id = companies.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = purchase_return_receipts.currency_center_id WHERE purchase_return_receipts.purchase_return_id = #{filter.billReturnId} AND is_void = 0

SELECT invoice_pbc_with_pbs.id AS id, invoice_pbc_with_pbs.purchase_return_id AS billReturnId, purchase_orders.id AS purchaseBillId, (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id = purchase_orders.vendor_id) AS vendorName, purchase_orders.po_code AS purchaseBillCode, purchase_orders.order_date AS orderDate, purchase_orders.total_amount AS totalAmount, invoice_pbc_with_pbs.total_cost AS paid, DATE(invoice_pbc_with_pbs.created) AS `date` FROM invoice_pbc_with_pbs LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = invoice_pbc_with_pbs.purchase_order_id WHERE invoice_pbc_with_pbs.purchase_return_id = #{filter.billReturnId} AND invoice_pbc_with_pbs.status = 1
